# Relay route survey

A walk of the pilot route beneath the monorail, receiver site by receiver
site. Its front matter carries the relay's project tag, so the **Hubs** view
files it under Ghostline Relay, and its first line in the editor says so.

## Sites

- **North stair.** Good cover, but the stairwell echoes; the receiver goes
  on the landing, not the ceiling.
- **Market arcade.** Busiest stretch of the route, and the reason the opt-out
  corridor runs along its east wall.
- **South Spindle.** The last site before the flood line. Kenji's exit map
  marks where the water reaches in a bad week.
